title: Barton Courtyard | What should change at the summer garden?
titleZh: 巴頓庭院｜夏季菜園該做哪些調整？
passage:
The Thursday harvest is open to residents whether or not they work in the garden. Anyone who comes in can pick vegetables from the marked beds. We do not normally set anything aside for people who cannot pick their own; once the Thursday volunteers leave, any vegetables they have collected go to the community kitchen. At present, the volunteers write down what was picked but not what was still available.

Nina said an earlier opening would let her in before work. Sam replied, ‘A path to the harvest isn’t the same as a share of it.’ Sam is already free on Thursdays. He said that he enjoys choosing vegetables to cook, but cannot pick them himself. He had asked the garden team for a small selection when they were already gathering vegetables, but had been told there was no way to leave it for him to collect.

The proposed budget follows a principle residents adopted last year: spend money to reduce tasks that are repeated each week, not just to make the first week easier. The main exception is an item that allows a household to participate in a way it previously could not. If an expense fits that exception, say which barrier it removes rather than claiming it saves time.

Looking at the storage plans, volunteers currently bring a crate downstairs from the tool room each Thursday and take it back afterwards. A permanent shelf beside the harvest table would still need to be cleared after every session; our upstairs room is the only place where supplies can stay overnight. The kitchen has offered us a small cabinet in the lobby for a small seasonal fee. It would be available during the harvest and until the end of the evening. Volunteers would still have to carry the crate, but the cabinet could hold a selection labelled for later collection.
passageZh:
週四採收開放給住戶，不論是否在菜園幫忙都能參加。進入菜園的住戶可以從標示過的菜畦自行採摘。我們通常不會為無法自行採摘的人另外留菜；週四的志工一離開，他們採下的蔬菜就會送到社區廚房。目前志工會記錄摘了什麼，但不記錄當時還剩什麼可摘。

妮娜說，提早開放就能讓她在上班前進去。山姆回道：「有路能走到菜畦，不等於我就分得到菜。」山姆週四本來就有空。他說自己喜歡挑菜做飯，但無法自己採摘。他曾請菜園小組在原本就要採收時順便摘幾樣給他，卻被告知沒辦法留給他稍後領取。

預算提案沿用住戶去年訂的原則：花錢要能減少每週重複做的工作，而不是只讓第一週輕鬆一點。主要例外是能讓某戶住戶用原先無法做到的方式參與的物品。若這筆支出符合這項例外，請說清楚它消除了什麼障礙，而不是聲稱它能省時間。

就物品存放來看，志工目前每週四都要把一個箱子從樓上的工具間搬下來，活動後再搬回去。即使在採收桌旁加裝固定置物架，每場活動結束仍得清空，因為只有樓上的房間能讓物品存放過夜。社區廚房願意以一筆不高的季租費出租大廳的小櫃子，讓大家從採收開始一直用到當晚結束。志工仍得搬箱子，但可以把分好、貼上標籤的蔬菜放進櫃子，讓住戶稍後領取。
